origin.measurement: effective options after virtual/project config and matrix expansion

enumeration_contract.case_id: the pinned expansion/inventory case id, including its matrix suffix
enumeration_contract.matrix_key: the exact case-id suffix after the first #; default when absent
enumeration_contract.effective_option_order: virtual tsconfig/project config options, then fixture/descriptor settings, then matrix overrides
enumeration_contract.positive_definition: sourceMap, inlineSourceMap, or inlineSources is explicitly true, or sourceRoot/mapRoot is explicitly nonempty
enumeration_contract.negative_definition: the case has a map-family option but no positive facet; explicit false boolean values remain controls
enumeration_contract.observations: none; this m-1 artifact is authoring-side census data only
